techStack: Runtime/framework: Express.js v5.2.1 on Node.js with TypeScript v6.0.2 (ES2023 target)
Database client: better-sqlite3 v12.11.1 — synchronous SQLite, raw SQL only, no ORM or query builder
Query pattern: parameterized SQL via db.prepare('... WHERE ? ...').get(val) / .all([...params, limit, offset])
Conditions array convention: conditions: string[] joined with AND, params: (string|number)[] spread into .all()
Testing: Vitest v4.1.5 + supertest v7.2.2 (integration tests hit real SQLite :memory: DB in test mode)
TypeScript strict mode: noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters — any added param must be used
features: Supported filters: search (LOWER LIKE), category (LOWER = LOWER), inStock (in_stock = ?), featured (BUG: JS post-query), sort (ORDER BY enum map)
search, category, inStock are already pushed into the SQL WHERE via the conditions/params arrays
featured is NOT in the conditions array — applied in JavaScript AFTER the paginated SELECT returns rows (lines 67-69)
COUNT query is a separate hardcoded 'SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM products' with no WHERE clause (lines 56-58)
totalPages formula is Math.floor(total / limit) — rounds down, drops the last partial page
pagination.test.ts: asserts totalPages=2 for 15 products/limit=10 (ceil semantics) — currently fails; asserts totalPages=3 for 15/limit=5 (exact division)
products.test.ts: covers search, category, inStock, sort, pagination envelope shape, auth middleware — all must continue to pass
architecture: Layer order: productRoutes.ts → productController.ts → productService.ts → db/client.ts (better-sqlite3 singleton)
Controller calls parseProductQuery(req.query) → returns ProductQuery, then passes to queryProducts(query)
ProductQuery interface fields: search?, category?, inStock?, featured?, sort?, page?, limit? (all optional, validated by Zod in queryParser.ts)
productService.ts getProducts(): builds conditions[] and params[] incrementally, assembles WHERE, runs SELECT then separate COUNT
conditions array is built once (lines 31-45) and used only for the SELECT WHERE (line 48); the COUNT at lines 56-58 ignores it entirely
db imported as singleton from ../db/client; all queries use db.prepare().get() / .all()
getFeaturedProducts() at line 100 is a separate function (JOIN with featured_overrides) — unrelated to getProducts() and must not be touched
edgeCases: Exact division (15 products, limit=5): ceil(15/5)=3 = floor(15/5)=3 — formula change is safe, must not regress
Single-page filtered result (4 electronics, limit=10): ceil(4/10)=1, not 0 — requirement 1
featured+pagination (featured=true, limit=3): SQL WHERE must apply before LIMIT/OFFSET so exactly 3 featured items are returned — requirement 3
inStock=false: SQL condition must be in_stock = 0; total must reflect only out-of-stock count — requirements 2 and 7
Combined filters: COUNT and SELECT must share the identical conditions[]/params[] so total always reflects the intersection of all active filters — requirement 2
No filter active: conditions[] is empty, WHERE clause is omitted, bare COUNT(*) FROM products is correct — requirements 5, 6, 7
featured condition must be added to conditions[] before the WHERE string is assembled and before the COUNT query runs, so both queries see it

The where variable (or equivalent construction) must be reused, not duplicated.

tasks.requirement: Requirements 4, 5, and 6: totalPages must use ceiling division so the last partial page is not dropped
